detailsTitle: Tell us a little about yourself
phoneHint: Only to send your token by SMS
phoneInvalid: Enter a 10-digit mobile number starting with 6, 7, 8 or 9.
smsOptIn: Send my queue token and position to this number by SMS
dangerTitle: Do you have any of these right now?
dangerSubtitle: Tap all that apply. If none, tap “No, none of these”.
dangerAlert: Please tell the staff at the desk now. You can keep answering here.
orSpeak: Or answer in your own words
voiceHeard: We heard you. Please check the words below.
voiceNothing: We could not hear you clearly. Please try again or tap an answer.
voiceDenied: Microphone permission was denied. Please tap or type your answer.
voiceFailed: Voice is not working right now. Please tap or type your answer.
voiceUnavailable: Voice answers are not available on this kiosk. Please tap or type.
voiceOff: Without AI help, please tap or type your answers.
typePlaceholder: Your answer (you can edit what we heard)
quitBody: Your answers will not be sent to the doctor and you will not get a token.
reviewSubtitle: Check your answers. Tap “Change” to fix anything.
waitHint: Please sit in the waiting area. Your token number will be called.
scanQr: Scan to follow your turn on your phone
autoRestart: This screen will reset in {{seconds}} seconds for the next patient.
helpSent: A staff member is coming to help you. Please stay here.
helpAsk: Do you want a staff member to come and help you?
helpFailed: Please wave to the staff at the desk.
errorRetry: Something went wrong. Please try again or ask staff for help.
connectionRetry: The connection dropped. Please tap again. Your answers are kept.
sessionLost: This check-in has ended. Please start again.
scanFound: We found these medicines. Please check and edit if needed.
scanNone: We could not read any medicine names. Please say or type them.
scanFailed: Could not read the photo. Please say or type the medicine names.
scanTooLarge: That photo is too large. Please take the photo again.
scanNotPhoto: That file is not a photo. Please take a photo of the prescription.
returningTitle: Have you visited this hospital before?
returningLead: If you have your OPD card, the doctor can see your earlier visits.
returningYes: Yes, I have my OPD card
returningNo: No, or I don't have my card
opdCardHint: Your earlier visits go to the doctor. They are not shown on this screen.
followUpTitle: Is today's visit about the same problem as your visit on {{date}}?
followUpLead: This helps the doctor see what has changed.
opdCardKeep: Keep this number and PIN. At your next visit, enter them so the doctor can see your earlier visits.
papersLead: Do you have old prescriptions, test reports or discharge papers? Take a photo of each one so the doctor can see it.
papersRead: AI will read them for the doctor, who checks each one against the photo.
papersNotRead: The doctor will look at the photos.
papersKept: The photos are kept with today's visit. You can remove a photo before you confirm.
papersPick: What paper is it? Tap to take a photo.
papersFull: You have added the most photos. Show any other papers to the doctor.
papersFailed: Could not save the photo. Please try again.
papersNotPhoto: That file is not a photo. Please take a photo of the paper.
